items.event_title: Solvay to more than double Taiwan semiconductor-grade peroxide capacity
items.news_summary: Solvay plans to increase ultra-pure hydrogen peroxide capacity in Taiwan from about 35,000 tonnes to more than 70,000 tonnes annually by end-2026 and aims to triple its electronic-grade peroxide business over five to seven years.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high: a less crowded upstream signal of sub-5nm fab expansion and AI-driven semiconductor materials demand, especially around TSMC's Taiwan capacity.
items.selection_reason: Concrete capacity expansion in a critical but underfollowed semiconductor consumables niche.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting with company capacity targets.

items.investor_materiality: High macro read-through for global yields, Japanese carry trades, exporters and U.S. risk assets if BOJ tightening expectations strengthen.
items.selection_reason: Fresh official comments arrive while global bond yields are elevated and the yen/BOJ path can transmit quickly into global equity positioning.
